name: Universal Logistics - Louisville Terminal - Louisville KY

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to 2338 Millers Ln, Louisville KY 40216 via loadmatch.com directory (Universal Intermodal Services) and the Crown Enterprises real-estate listing (gocrown.ws), which is the Moroun-family property company that holds ULH/Universal real estate. Crown's Google Maps embed placed the parcel at 38.214222,-85.802804.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (2024-07) from Millers Lane shows the yard frontage fully open — no barrier arm, no sliding/swing gate, no fencing across the truck driveway at the public road. Trucks enter directly off Millers Lane.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the entrance or anywhere on the property in satellite or Street View. Only the metal-sided terminal/office building is present.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Crown Enterprises listing states 46 cross-dock doors on the 16,195 SF terminal building; satellite confirms a long narrow cross-dock building with trailers backed against both long faces. Banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Yard (mostly gravel/dirt) is filled with stacked ocean containers and parked trailers/chassis — clearly a working drop/storage yard. Banded 50+.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Open paved/gravel apron and internal yard provide ample stacking depth between the road and the dock building — 3+ trucks could queue.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Three structures per the property record: 16,195 SF terminal, 2,516 SF warehouse, 4,880 SF office (the office is integrated into the terminal building's near end).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into this parcel. It is a drayage/cross-dock terminal that trucks containers to/from the nearby CSX Osborn intermodal ramp; rail does not enter the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Louisville metro industrial fabric (40216 / I-264 corridor) — Urban.

citations.claim: Crown Enterprises (Moroun, holds ULH real estate) lists 2338 Millers Lane as a 23,591 SF terminal, 46 cross-dock doors, 4.72 acres, exact building match
Names 'Mason-Dixon Intermodal d/b/a Universal Intermodal Services' as a ULH single-employer entity

verification.rationale: Independent sources place the ULH intermodal operator at the exact 46-door Crown-owned building; only 2025 negative is a non-cash impairment, no WARN/closure.
